card.name: Words introducing size or distance comparisons
card.fires_on: Small linking words (about, than, to, as, from, if) right before a physical size, distance or comparison to an object. Typical setting is describing how big or far something is.

modes.label: Approximate measures
modes.description: Words like about or to placed just before a length or distance value.
modes.example: tubercle on the iliac crest<< about>> 5 cm. behind the anterior superior

modes.label: Size compared to objects
modes.description: Linking words such as than, as, or to before a familiar object used for scale.
modes.example: barely larger<< than>> your big toe, need to make it

modes.label: Reach or direction
modes.description: Words like toward, up to, or from before a place or extent.
modes.example: plants that came up<< to>> my knees," he said.

card.writes: It adds a push toward words about sweeping, range and extent, though the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before a size, distance or "as big as" comparison.
